interaction_scope: publicly declared fixed pick action over all visible candidates; object selection and exact confirmation only; no main-task/missing-action inference claim

binding_gate.scope: independent repair-job selected VLM validation traces; not re-generated here

binding.source: predicted candidate weights and public aliases in frozen native VLM embeddings; no target text

data_binding.scope: actual LIBERO captures; fixed historical questions; simulated latent-outcome calibration

online_audit_preregistered_criteria.probability_diagnostic: report calibrated-vs-raw online NLL; negative result is not an implementation failure
online_audit_preregistered_criteria.selection_resolution_rule: all four conditions resolved per base; any wrong submission per base
